identity.title: Automatic Actuation of Containment Isolation Valves during Testing

cause.proximate_text: The direct cause of this event was opening Turbine Stop Valves with main condenser vacuum below 10 inches Hg... This event resulted from legacy procedural inadequacies. In 2019 the Turbine Control System (TCS) digital upgrade modification changed the test procedure ... to a TCS automatically controlled test opening all four Turbine Stop Valves. This procedure change did not add a prerequisite to ensure condenser vacuum was greater than the Condenser Vacuum Low - Group 1 isolation setpoint prior to beginning the test.
cause.theme: legacy procedural inadequacy following digital control system modification

nodes.theme: legacy procedural inadequacy following digital control system modification
nodes.proximate_text: The direct cause of this event was opening Turbine Stop Valves with main condenser vacuum below 10 inches Hg. This event resulted from legacy procedural inadequacies: the 2019 TCS digital upgrade changed the test procedure to open all four Turbine Stop Valves automatically, but did not add a prerequisite ensuring condenser vacuum was above the Group 1 isolation setpoint.

nodes.display_name: Test procedure lacked condenser vacuum prerequisite
nodes.description: 2019 TCS digital upgrade changed test to open all four Turbine Stop Valves automatically without requiring condenser vacuum above the Group 1 isolation setpoint first.

nodes.display_name: Turbine Stop Valves opened with condenser vacuum below setpoint
nodes.description: Turbine Stop Valves were opened per the Tightness Test procedure while main condenser vacuum was below the 10 inches Hg Condenser Vacuum Low - Group 1 isolation setpoint.

nodes.display_name: Condenser Vacuum Low - Group 1 isolation signal automatically un-bypassed
nodes.description: Per design, opening the Turbine Stop Valves automatically removed the bypass on the Condenser Vacuum Low - Group 1 isolation signal (normally bypassed below 500 psig reactor vessel pressure).
With condenser vacuum below the 10 inches Hg setpoint and the bypass removed, a Group 1 isolation signal occurred per design.

nodes.display_name: Automatic actuation of Group 1 PCIVs (MSIVs and associated isolation valves)
Revise Unit 1 and Unit 2 Turbine Control/Stop Valves Tightness Test procedures to require condenser vacuum >10 inches Hg prior to test
Previous similar event: automatic PCIS actuation
nodes.title: automatic PCIS actuation

chain: legacy procedural inadequacy (2019 TCS upgrade omitted vacuum prerequisite) [cause TBD] -> Turbine Stop Valves opened with condenser vacuum below setpoint -> Condenser Vacuum Low - Group 1 isolation signal automatically un-bypassed -> Group 1 isolation signal generated per design -> automatic actuation of Group 1 PCIVs (MSIVs reopened within ~20 min)
notes: Cause code left TBD/provisional per FORM-366 (no official cause code provided). Previous similar event is only vaguely described as 'automatic PCIS actuation' with no LER number, plant, or unit given in narrative; stub LER key set to 'unknown' since no identifiable report number was stated. Turbine Control Valves remained closed throughout event; included as component for context of the isolation logic but not part of failure chain beyond design description.
